notes.title: Coolest Demo Update so far
notes.content:
Hi!  

Your one-man army EmotionalDamage is here.  
(I have 2 cardinals tho..)

I have prepared a grandiose Demo update I’ve worked on for a month.  

I had a critical issue for streamers playing my game exposing their connection string, so now we have a LOBBY! 
You can currently only invite your Steam friends, and you can join the game only during that time for better session management and less annoying networking bugzzz.  

Also, I didn’t have a tutorial in my game before, so now there is an giant tableau with your duty instructions right in your ship! 
(Still no tutorial, but my vision is that you just need a general knowledge, and then it’s more fun to figure everything else out yourself!)  

And at least 4 new monsters and an eye laser rework!  

I, together with Alejandro and Chaunceey, have already play-tested this version and I’ve written down a whole page in my notebook with the next prioritized improvements I’ll be working on from now. 

I feel the game is becoming something whole and genuinely enjoyable.  

Meet your quota! 

— EmotionalDamage

notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.content:
I've been working hard to eliminate all technical bugs I could and add most content I wanted.


Basically you can now try pre-release game content via Demo which will be available for a while.
Hope to hear your feedback on Discord.



-EmotionalDamage

notes.title: The Demo Approaches
notes.content:
I'm here to mark one of the upcoming public milestones - Demo is on it's way to become available for everyone to try.
Supposedly, it lands next week.
And when it does, you're welcome to test a raw excerpt of core gameplay.

- Yours, EmotionalDamage
